name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: August Week 9 - Ultrasonic Design
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: A sensor that uses sound to measure distance.
words.example: The ultrasonic sensor measured the distance to the box.

words.definition: How far apart two things are.
words.example: The distance reading showed how far the object was.

words.definition: A sound or signal that bounces back.
words.example: The echo signal returned after the sound bounced back.
The trigger pin started the distance measurement.

words.definition: A small unit for measuring length.
words.example: The group recorded each distance in centimeters.

words.definition: A limit where an action changes.
words.example: The threshold set the distance that started the alert.

words.definition: An early version used for testing.
words.example: The prototype used a sensor, LED, and buzzer.

words.definition: A planned test with expected behavior.
words.example: The test case checked what happened at 10 centimeters.
